findings.message: The error from json.Unmarshal is discarded, so a malformed body imports nothing (or only part of the list) and the client still gets 204 No Content. Reject invalid JSON with 400 instead of reporting success.
io.ReadAll reads the whole request body with no size limit, so a single large upload can exhaust the server's memory. Cap the body with http.MaxBytesReader before reading it.

Widgets are created one by one outside a transaction, so a failure part-way through returns 500 while the earlier widgets stay created; a client that retries the import then creates duplicates. Run the batch in one transaction or report which names were imported.
